name: PMC8607803-deep-bite-worn-opg
source: Figure 4 initial panoramic radiograph from ‘Rehabilitation of a deep bite patient with worn dentition using minimally invasive approach: A 3-year follow-up,’ Mahya Hasanzade, Safoura Ghodsi and Negin Yaghoobi, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8607803/. Licensed CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Image reproduced unchanged. Reported plan: ceramic occlusal overlays on mandibular posterior teeth, porcelain-fused-to-zirconia crowns and lithium-disilicate laminates anteriorly, plus two fixed partial dentures for missing maxillary teeth; no implants.

intake.freeText: My teeth are very worn and short, especially the front ones, and I have a deep bite. I also have some gaps where teeth are missing in the upper jaw. I'd like to restore my smile and be able to chew properly — what options do I have?
